storyline.title: What exactly did we build?
storyline.jury_question: Is this merely a classifier demo, or is there an actual system architecture?
storyline.proof: GreenPulse contains separate vision, sensor-contract, time-sync, registry, safety-gate, active-learning, audit and hardware-contract layers.
storyline.speaker_line: GreenPulse'u yalnızca bir YOLO modeli olarak kurmadık. Görüntü çıkarımından model kayıt defterine, güvenlik kapısına, insan incelemeli aktif öğrenmeye, denetime ve donanım sözleşmesine kadar modüler bir yapay zekâ mimarisi kurduk.
storyline.do_not_claim: Do not say real greenhouse closed-loop operation is already validated.

storyline.title: How did we prevent test leakage?
storyline.jury_question: How do we know your final accuracy was not optimized against the test set?
storyline.proof: Model selection ended on validation. The final checkpoint was frozen before final-test exposure. Tomato final test was consumed once, and post-test analysis used saved predictions only.
storyline.speaker_line: En önemli metodolojik kararımız budur: nihai test, model seçimine katılmadı. Kontrol noktası önce donduruldu, test yalnızca bir kez açıldı ve sonraki analizler model çıkarımıyla değil, kaydedilmiş tahminler üzerinden yapıldı.
storyline.do_not_claim: Do not call the full tomato dataset physically leaf-independent; unmapped physical identity remains unknown.

storyline.title: Did the model actually converge?
storyline.jury_question: What happened during training, and was the reported model simply an old checkpoint?
storyline.proof: A new tomato clean experiment used a generic pretrained base only; the historical tomato checkpoint was not used.
storyline.speaker_line: Domates modelini önceki domates kontrol noktasından başlatmadık. Genel ön eğitimli bir temelden temiz bir deney kurduk ve model seçimini doğrulama sonuçlarına dayandırdık.
storyline.do_not_claim: Do not present training accuracy alone as generalization.

storyline.title: What does the frozen test actually show?
storyline.jury_question: Where does the 10-class tomato model fail?
storyline.proof: Frozen final-test accuracy = 0.991597, Macro F1 = 0.989933, with 23 errors across 2,737 images.
storyline.speaker_line: Yalnızca %99 doğruluk demiyoruz. Karışıklık matrisi ve hata çifti analiziyle modelin tam olarak nerede yanıldığını da gösteriyoruz. 2.737 dondurulmuş test örneğinde 23 hata var.
storyline.do_not_claim: Do not describe 99.16% as real-greenhouse accuracy.

storyline.title: Can we inspect what the network attends to?
storyline.jury_question: Is the network relying on plausible image regions?
storyline.proof: Grad-CAM evidence is generated on validation samples with preprocessing parity to standard YOLO inference.
storyline.speaker_line: Model kararını yalnızca sınıf etiketi olarak saklamıyoruz. Doğrulama örneklerinde Grad-CAM ile ağın dikkat ettiği bölgeleri görsel olarak denetleyebiliyoruz.
storyline.do_not_claim: Grad-CAM is qualitative explainability, not lesion segmentation, pixel-level localization or causal proof.

storyline.title: Did transfer learning really improve pepper?
storyline.jury_question: Did tomato-to-pepper transfer outperform a generic baseline?
storyline.proof: Both transfer and generic baseline reached identical validation accuracy; therefore transfer advantage was not claimed.
storyline.speaker_line: Burada sonucu şişirmedik. Domatesten başlayan transfer modeli ile genel temel model doğrulamada aynı sonucu verdi. Bu nedenle transfer üstünlüğünü kanıtlanmış gibi sunmuyoruz.
storyline.do_not_claim: Do not claim transfer learning demonstrated superiority.

storyline.title: How well did the second crop generalize?
storyline.jury_question: Was the second crop independently evaluated?
storyline.proof: Pepper frozen final-test accuracy = 0.981132, Macro F1 = 0.980212 on 371 images.
storyline.speaker_line: İkinci ürünü yalnızca doğrulama sonucuyla kapatmadık. 371 örneklik ayrı bir dondurulmuş testte doğruluk %98,11 ve Makro F1 0,9802 oldu.
storyline.do_not_claim: Do not claim the pepper result proves performance under greenhouse domain shift.

storyline.title: Will the exported model behave like the PyTorch model?
storyline.jury_question: How do you know ONNX export did not alter predictions?
storyline.proof: Tomato and pepper ONNX validation showed matching Top-1 predictions with extremely small probability differences.
storyline.speaker_line: Uç birim dağıtımı için yalnızca ONNX dışa aktarımı yapmadık. PyTorch ve ONNX çıktılarını örnek örnek karşılaştırarak tahmin eşitliğini ayrıca doğruladık.
storyline.do_not_claim: ONNX parity is not Raspberry Pi or Hailo deployment validation.

storyline.title: What happens when the crop is unsupported?
storyline.jury_question: Will the model blindly make a prediction for any crop?
storyline.proof: Registry contains tomato and bell pepper only. Unsupported crops, including cucumber in current scope, are blocked under ABSTAIN policy.
storyline.speaker_line: Sistem bilinmeyen bir ürün gördüğünde en yakın modele zorunlu yönlendirme yapmaz. Kayıt defterinde bulunmayan ürün için politika ABSTAIN/BLOCK'tur.
storyline.do_not_claim: Crop identity itself is currently an unverified external claim.

storyline.title: How does GreenPulse handle uncertainty?
storyline.jury_question: Does the system automatically learn from uncertain samples?
storyline.proof: Low-confidence, OOD, conflict and image-quality cases can enter a human review queue; automatic labeling and retraining remain disabled.
storyline.speaker_line: Aktif öğrenmeyi özerk yeniden eğitim olarak kurmadık. Riskli ve belirsiz örnekler insan inceleme kuyruğuna düşer; otomatik etiketleme ve otomatik yeniden eğitim yasaktır.
storyline.do_not_claim: Do not imply the system self-updates in production.

storyline.title: What is complete today?
storyline.jury_question: What are the final verified AI/ML results?
storyline.proof: Computer-side disease classification is closed for tomato and bell pepper, with model, test, explainability, ONNX and governance evidence. Current deployment mode is RESEARCH-ONLY; operational release is not approved and physical actuation remains disabled.
storyline.speaker_line: Bugün kapatılmış kapsam iki üründür: domates ve dolmalık biber. Her ikisi için dondurulmuş test, açıklanabilirlik, ONNX eşitliği ve kayıt defteri kanıtı mevcuttur. Mevcut dağıtım durumumuz yalnızca araştırmadır; operasyonel sürüm onaylanmamıştır ve fiziksel eyleme devre dışıdır.
storyline.do_not_claim: Do not say the complete greenhouse product is finished.

storyline.title: What is intentionally not claimed yet?
storyline.jury_question: Which parts still require hardware and greenhouse validation?
storyline.proof: Real greenhouse, calibrated water stress, Hailo runtime, physical closed loop and measured savings remain pending.
storyline.speaker_line: Projenin gücü yalnızca yüksek metriklerde değil, kanıtlamadığımız şeyi iddia etmememizdedir. Bu sütunda yazılım tarafında kapattığımız bölümleri, diğer sütunda ise gerçek donanım geldikten sonra ölçülecek bölümleri ayırdık.
storyline.do_not_claim: Do not claim 45% water saving, 30% energy saving, early stress detection hours, Hailo latency or <3 GB RAM until physically measured.

rapid_fire.question: Why YOLO11n?
rapid_fire.answer: We selected a lightweight Ultralytics classification architecture suitable for later edge deployment. Current ONNX parity is verified; Hailo runtime is not yet validated.

rapid_fire.question: Why not use test data during model selection?
rapid_fire.answer: Because that would bias the reported final estimate. Model selection was validation-only, followed by checkpoint freeze and one-time held-out evaluation.

rapid_fire.question: Is Grad-CAM proof of disease localization?
rapid_fire.answer: No. It is a qualitative attention diagnostic only. We do not claim pixel-level lesion segmentation.

rapid_fire.question: Did transfer learning beat the baseline?
rapid_fire.answer: No demonstrated advantage was observed on validation; both candidates reached identical validation accuracy.

rapid_fire.question: Can the current system irrigate autonomously?
rapid_fire.answer: No. Physical actuation is explicitly disabled in the current research-only software state.

rapid_fire.question: What happens for cucumber?
rapid_fire.answer: Cucumber is outside the current two-crop scope and has no registered model, so routing is blocked under the abstention policy.

rapid_fire.question: Does ONNX parity mean Hailo deployment is complete?
rapid_fire.answer: No. It proves export-level consistency only. HEF conversion, Pi/Hailo latency and memory remain hardware-stage tasks.

scientific_boundary.verified_scope: Tomato + Bell Pepper computer-side disease classification
